source.description: A hooded silhouette of living black smoke with long clawed arms and glowing white eyes, its form rippling and wisping continuously, edges dissolving and reforming. Seamless loop.

The smoky shadow fiend with glowing white eyes attacks — it condenses into a darker denser mass, then whips both elongated shadow claws forward toward the camera in a slashing cross, then dissolves back into its rippling form.

_notes: 1-direction object, side-scroller view. Idle animation stalled twice at 95%% and eventually failed server-side; retried and succeeded. Base sprite approved pre-session; self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
